introduction: Colorado SNAP provides food benefits through a Colorado Quest EBT card. Your county human services department reviews the application and determines eligibility.
description: Colorado SNAP provides food benefits through a Colorado Quest EBT card. Your county human services department reviews the application and determines eligibility.

sections.who: Low-income households may qualify, including working families and people receiving other assistance. Income, household composition and applicable work or student rules matter. The state’s overview contains older tables; use the county’s current assessment.
sections.get: Approved households receive a monthly food benefit. Participating produce-incentive programs may stretch eligible purchases, but store participation varies.

sections.apply:
1. Apply through a state channel

    Use the PEAK or MyCOBenefits links on the SNAP page. Paper applications can be mailed, faxed or delivered to the county office.

  2. Complete county follow-up

    Watch for interview calls or notices. Upload requested verification to PEAK or MyCOBenefits, or submit it to the county.

  3. Explain urgent food needs

    Tell the county if food and cash are running out so it can assess expedited processing. Ask where to get food while the application is pending.
sections.after: Keep the decision and interview notices. After approval, protect the card and PIN; the state recommends freezing the card when it is not in use.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Colorado SNAP application and case guidance. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: The county human services department determines eligibility and authorizes benefits.
Can I apply by phone app?
Yes. Colorado lists MyCOBenefits as an application option.
Do work rules apply to everyone?
No. Ask the county about the current rules and any exemption that fits your circumstances.
Ask the county to explain it and use the state’s dispute-resolution or fair-hearing instructions.
What if my card is compromised?
Contact your county immediately and follow the state’s EBT security guidance.
